narrative.overview:
A house at night. Surfaces are warm neutrals separated by 1px lines, never shadows. A single ember accent marks what you can act on: the primary button, the focus ring, the active item. Every service has a window light: lit green when it is up, red when it is down, an empty ring when unknown. The logo is a house with one lit window.

Dark is the intended default and light is a complete theme. Geist carries the interface and Geist Mono carries hosts, counts, and shortcuts. The home is a dense list with a Ctrl or Cmd K command palette; Cards remain as an option, switched from a single View popover.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark neutrals (hue 60-80, very low chroma) layered by tone and 1px borders.
Ember is the only brand hue; it may be text through the ember-text token.
StatusLight (dot plus text) is the status signature; the logo shares its idea.
Flat: no drop shadows; one 1px ember highlight on services that are up.
Dense list home, Ctrl or Cmd K palette, Geist plus Geist Mono.
shadcn/ui base (new-york, Radix, lucide, Tailwind v4), themed via the `dark` class.

rules.name: The Status-Needs-Words Rule
rules.body: The light is never alone: it always sits next to text.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Ember is the only brand hue. Green and red mean status only; do not add a second accent.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards, buttons, popovers, or fields. Depth comes from tone and 1px borders; focus uses a 3px ring.

dos: Do use ember for primary action, active item, focus, and (via accent-text) links and active icons.
Do show status with a StatusLight and words.
Do show hosts, ports, counts, and shortcuts in Geist Mono.
Do separate surfaces with tone and 1px borders.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue or decorative gradients.
Don't use drop shadows for elevation.
Don't communicate status by color alone.
Don't reintroduce uppercase wide-tracking labels outside tiny mono captions.
